final_survivor_classification.argument: For contiguous nonempty batches covering all valid step indexes, a step equal to end_step belongs to the next batch. The mutation also matches the previous batch, but the ascending scan subsequently overwrites the mapping with the correct next batch. The final end_step equals step_count and cannot be a valid dependency index. All other step indexes are unaffected.

fixture_sources.reproduce.py:
"""Real Mull probe: one union binary, two narrower YAMLs, matching indexed profiles."""
from pathlib import Path
import os, subprocess, hashlib, json, sqlite3
here=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
# YAMLs and sources next to this script are the complete fixture.
env=dict(os.environ, MULL_CONFIG=str(here/'all.yml'))
compile_args=['clang++','-g','-O0','-grecord-command-line','-fpass-plugin='+os.environ['MULL_PLUGIN'],
              '-fprofile-instr-generate','-fcoverage-mapping',str(here/'main.cpp'),'-o',str(here/'probe')]
subprocess.run(compile_args,env=env,check=True,stdout=(here/'compile.log').open('w'),stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
result={'mull_version':subprocess.check_output(['mull-runner-22','--version'],text=True),
        'compile_args':compile_args,'binary_sha256':hashlib.sha256((here/'probe').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'reports':{}}
for scope in ('ranges','dag'):
    env=dict(os.environ,LLVM_PROFILE_FILE=str(here/f'{scope}.profraw'))
    subprocess.run([str(here/'probe'),scope],env=env,check=True)
    subprocess.run(['llvm-profdata','merge','-sparse',str(here/f'{scope}.profraw'),'-o',str(here/f'{scope}.profdata')],check=True)
    for inclusive in (False,True):
        name=scope+('_uncovered' if inclusive else '_covered')
        args=['mull-runner-22','--allow-surviving','--workers','1','--minimum-timeout','1000',
              '--coverage-info',str(here/f'{scope}.profdata'),'--reporters','SQLite','--report-dir',str(here),'--report-name',name]
        for path in os.environ.get('MULL_LIBRARY_PATH','').split(':'):
            if path:args+=['--ld-search-path',path]
        if inclusive:args+=['--include-not-covered']
        args+=[str(here/'probe'),scope]
        subprocess.run(args,env=dict(os.environ,MULL_CONFIG=str(here/f'{scope}.yml')),check=True,stdout=(here/f'{name}.log').open('w'),stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        with sqlite3.connect(here/f'{name}.sqlite') as db:
            rows=db.execute('SELECT filename,mutator,execution_status,mutant_id FROM mutant ORDER BY mutant_id').fetchall()
        result['reports'][name]=[dict(zip(['file','mutator','execution_status','mutant_id'],row)) for row in rows]
(here/'experiment.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:len(v) for k,v in result['reports'].items()}))
